note: All thresholds are VISHUE team-proposed internal targets, not published AR-makeup pass lines. 'milestone' = 1차 개발 목표 (never reported as pass of the item).

status_values.pass: all final conditions met on the fixed evaluation set
status_values.fail: measured and below the final threshold
status_values.in_progress: milestone met but final threshold not met (reported, never counted as pass)
status_values.not_measured: required data/statistic not available in this run
status_values.not_valid: measured, but the measurement floor of the data is above the threshold, so pass/fail cannot be decided with this data

validity.metric: median skin-ring dE between bare and real photo
validity.rule: if floor > 1.5 the dE<=1.5 conditions are not_valid

position.data: LaPa test lip masks (eval_lapa.py baseline_landmarks.csv), detected faces only

texture.data: lip_pairs (hw01_compare.py csv, methods ar and bare)
texture.pair_rule: pair passes when >= 2 of 3 are closer to real than bare: dL_spread_ar < dL_spread_bare, dL_hi_ar < dL_hi_bare, ssim_ar > ssim_bare (ties count as not closer)

naturalness.data: blind survey csv + key.csv; pair photos only for discrimination; AR creator excluded

conditions.metric: 95% CI upper of BA, rater-cluster bootstrap
VISHUE score = 6 - mean(survey score of AR pair photos)
